summary: the default suite's rows of devprobe, sigprobe and procprobe, with a fault in the kernel for each

faults.name: devprobe
faults.summary: a table entry numbered as a disk node in entry_index alone, so /dev/null and its listing differ in inode

lines: default-probe: fail: devprobe did not pass
fstat and the /dev listing give /dev/null one inode

faults.name: sigprobe
faults.summary: a one-shot handler reset before its frame is built, so the first one-shot delivery enters address zero and the probe dies

lines: default-probe: fail: sigprobe did not pass

faults.name: procprobe
faults.summary: two proc files with one inode: /proc/interrupts opened as the origin of /proc/loop

lines: default-probe: fail: procprobe did not pass
and the open files have different inodes too
